While you have an <arc/>Arc Melee Ability equipped:
Receiving Melee damage or scoring an <arc/>Arc Elemental Melee Hit grants the 'Cross Counter' buff for your next Melee Attack within 3 seconds.

Cross Counter grants 400% additional base Melee damage and restores 40 HP on Melee Hits. Cross Counter's Melee deals <arc/>Arc Damage.
